item.description:
0.1.0 - First Sparkle release

Auto-updates are now wired up. Future versions will install in-place via the standard "Check for Updates..." menu item.

Headline features

  • Live recording pill with audio meter + meeting title
  • Floating transcript HUD + in-meeting notes editor
  • Notes-aware summarisation (Qwen3 14B by default)
  • Persistent speaker identity (voice embeddings)
  • Per-meeting and per-app audio capture scopes
  • Calendar-driven title + participant auto-fill
  • System notifications for pre-meeting, app-launch, and idle
  • Vocabulary terms + replacement rules
  • Rename + delete meetings from the library
